+from itertools import combinations, product
+import heapq

+def _quota_intervals(data, capacity, tie):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if mandatory & blocked or k < len(mandatory):
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    if len(options) < k:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for selected in combinations(options, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in selected}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in selected:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+
+        active = []
+        compatible = True
+        for job in sorted(selected, key=lambda j: (j["start"], j["end"])):
+            while active and active[0] <= job["start"]:
+                heapq.heappop(active)
+            heapq.heappush(active, job["end"])
+            if len(active) > capacity:
+                compatible = False
+                break
+        if not compatible:
+            continue
+
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in selected)
+        selected_ids = sorted(ids)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and
+                 (selected_ids < best_ids if tie == "smallest" else selected_ids > best_ids))):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected_ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+
